weakProjection.sameDomainRule: The projection row inherits D_weak_visible_attempt_0001 and A_weak_attempt_0001 from the retained muon weak_visible_branch_ledger. It does not introduce a second weak domain, a replacement branch record, or a detached Standard Model sector label.
weakProjection.separationRule: Measured charged-lepton spectrum, polarization/lifetime, and Michel-fit rows remain separate from inferred neutral-lepton rows. The inferred neutral rows are bookkeeping rows inside the same weak-visible projection, not direct detector products.
weakProjection.massMapBoundary: The muon lifetime and spectrum are finite-window observer benchmarks. They do not assign physical mass to architrino primitives and do not populate a parent mass-map carrier by themselves.
